Definition: Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jericho = "its moon"; 1) a city 5 miles (8 km) west of the Jordan and 7 miles (11.5 km) north of the Dead Sea and the first city conquered by the Israelites upon entering the promised land of Canaan
